title: Process Engineer I, Biologics Manufacturing
text:
Process Engineer I, Biologics Manufacturing

About the role
Support a commercial monoclonal antibody facility. You will own process performance for upstream and downstream unit operations and support investigations and validation.

Responsibilities
- Monitor bioreactor and chromatography performance and trend batch data
- Author and revise SOPs and batch records
- Lead deviation investigations, root cause analysis and CAPA
- Support process validation and tech transfer

Requirements
- B.S. in Chemical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering or Chemistry, graduated between May 2025 and December 2026
- Working knowledge of GMP in a regulated manufacturing environment
- Data analysis skills in Python or MATLAB
- Experience with process validation

Preferred
- Experience with Six Sigma or Minitab
- Familiarity with HPLC
- Process simulation in Aspen Plus
- Hands-on cell culture experience

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States.
